title: English CEFR-aligned Question–Answer and MCQ Dataset
source_alignment: ANG.txt: EAQUALS/ALTE Can Do descriptors (2008), covering listening, reading, interaction, production, writing, strategies, and language quality.
important_note: These are newly authored practice items broadly aligned with the supplied descriptors, not official EAQUALS questions or a validated high-stakes examination. Open-ended answers are model answers or adaptable frames.
scoring_note: Every MCQ has five options scored exactly 0%, 20%, 50%, 75%, and 100%. These are rubric values for partial credit, not probabilities.
